en: Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!
Okay!\nI'll share!
We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!
All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!
Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\pThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.
We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!
Urgh!\nNow I'm mad!
You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!
We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\lWe strike fear with our strength!
I blew it!
Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!
We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!
So, you are good…
If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!
Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\pIt could be bad news!
I'm steamed!
POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.
Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?
Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?
Obtained the HELIX FOSSIL!
Obtained the DOME FOSSIL!
